async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Navigate to the project details page for a11yproject.com
    await navigate_to_project_details(page, "The A11Y Project / a11yproject.com")
    # Step 2: Click on the merge requests link for this project
    # In the accessibility tree, the merge requests link is under the heading with text '3'
    merge_requests_link = page.get_by_role("heading", name="The A11Y Project / a11yproject.com", level=2).get_by_role("link", name="3")
    await merge_requests_link.click()
    # Wait for the merge requests page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Step 3: Find the merge request related to color utility
    # Assuming the merge request has 'color' in its title or description
    # Use filter to find the correct merge request item
    merge_request_item = page.get_by_role("link").filter(has_text="color")
    await merge_request_item.click()
    # Wait for the merge request details page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Step 4: Post the comment 'Good idea'
    # Find the comment textbox and submit button
    comment_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Comment")
    await comment_textbox.fill("Good idea")
    submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Comment")
    await submit_button.click()
    # Wait for the comment to be posted
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
